question.problem:
Which of the following statements are true?

I. There are $7$ distinct residue classes modulo $8$

II. $[4]_{6}\cap [15]_{6}\ne ∅$

III. $Z=[5]_{2}\cup [10]_{2}$
question.worked_solution:
Recall that the residue classes modulo $n$ have the following properties:

- There are exactly $n$ distinct residue classes modulo $n$

- Two distinct residue classes have an empty intersection: $[a]_{n}\cap [b]_{n}=∅$ if $a≢b\,(\text{mod}\,n)$

- Residue classes modulo $n$ form a partition of the set of all integers: 

$$
Z=[0]_{n}\cup [1]_{n}\cup ⋯\cup [n-1]_{n}
$$

- The integers modulo $n$ is defined as the set containing all distinct residue classes modulo $n$: 

$$
{Z}_{n}=\{[0]_{n},\,[1]_{n},\,…,\,[n-1]_{n}\}
$$

With that in mind, let's now consider each of the given statements.

- Statement I is false. There are exactly $8$ distinct residue classes modulo $8.$

- Statement II is false. Since $4≢15\,(\text{mod }6),$ we have that $[4]_{6}\cap [15]_{6}=∅.$

- Statement III is true. First, notice the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}[5]_{2} & =[1+2\cdot 2]_{2}=[1]_{2} \\ [10]_{2} & =[0+2\cdot 5]_{2}=[0]_{2}\end{aligned}
$$

As a result, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}[5]_{2}\cup [10]_{2} & =[1]_{2}\cup [0]_{2} \\  & =[0]_{2}\cup [1]_{2} \\  & =Z\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the correct answer is "III only".
